# Branch (`branch` v1)

A branch: customers, deposits and lending, product mix and service scores.

**Group:** Retail banking · **Mnemonic:** `BRN` · **Identifiers:** `BRN-…` in `branchId`

Open one with `BRN <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: branch
version: 1
description: "A branch: customers, deposits and lending, product mix and service scores."
match: { kind: branch, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Retail banking · Branch, id: $.branchId }
strip:
  - { label: Branch, bind: $.name }
  - { label: City, bind: $.city }
  - { label: Customers, bind: $.customers, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Deposits, bind: $.deposits, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Lending, bind: $.lending, fmt: compact }
  - { label: NPS, bind: $.nps, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: mix
    kind: hbar
    title: Balances by product
    key: F2
    rows: $.productMix
    label: product
    value: balance
    fmt: compact
  - id: nps
    kind: line
    title: Net promoter score by month
    area: right
    rows: $.npsHistory
    x: month
    y: nps
    fmt: amount0
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
